# Third-party build files

The release builder expects these two files in this directory:

- `RenderHook.dll`
- `Interop.RenderHookLib.dll`

They are the SkunkVision RenderHook component and generated managed COM interop
assembly used by AC World Gamma.

They are bundled in the tested release installer. Attribution and the applicable
MIT notice are in `../THIRD_PARTY_NOTES.txt`.
